market_news.title: Company, union members speak on Parker Lord strike
market_news.summary: Union members at Parker Lord Erie are on their second day of a strike, fighting for fair wages and a three-year contract. They claim the company, which manufactures aerospace components, is not keeping up with inflation despite making record profits since its acquisition by Parker Hannifin in 2019. While the company expressed disappointment in the strike, union members are waiting for management to return to the bargaining table.

Investors are now focused on J&J's upcoming Q4 earnings report on January 21, anticipating updates on litigation and its 2026 outlook.

market_news.title: Citigroup stock slides after-hours on reported job cuts as credit-card rate cap looms

Investors are closely watching upcoming earnings reports from major banks for insights into consumer spending and credit conditions amidst these challenges.

market_news.title: Amgen to announce data on obesity drug MariTide at healthcare conference
market_news.summary: Amgen is preparing to release new data on its experimental obesity drug MariTide at the J.P. Morgan Healthcare Conference, expressing strong confidence in its potential. MariTide employs a unique mechanism, activating the GLP-1 receptor while blocking the GIP receptor, and further studies are underway.
